questions.question: Whose psalm/prayer is Psalm 72, a prayer for the king?
What does the psalm pray the king will do for the needy?
options: Conquer the nations and take their wealth
Gather the wise and rule by their counsel
Build the temple and adorn the city
Defend the poor and deliver the needy
questions.answer: Defend the poor and deliver the needy

questions.question: The psalm prays the king will have dominion from sea to sea.
May he have dominion from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the _____!
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous _____.
